title: Preference-Aware Pareto Steering for Multi-Task Speech LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech large language models (LLMs) perform multiple tasks, including automatic speech recognition (ASR), timestamp prediction (TS), and speech translation (ST). Joint training of speech LLMs creates task trade-offs, yet standard training with fixed loss weights does not generally control the resulting trade-off according to deployment preferences. To address this, we propose Endpoint-Anchored Preference-Aware Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front (EA-SURF), an a priori method that adapts scalarization weights so that the resulting task trade-off reflects the desired preference. EA-SURF retains the standard weighted-loss training pipeline, tracking the current model's performance relative to each task-specific reference and adapting the scalarization weights as training proceeds. We theoretically show that EA-SURF can match a desired preference, with the update becoming stationary at the target under checkable regularity conditions.

translated_title: 面向多任务语音大语言模型的偏好感知帕累托调控
translated_abstract: 语音大语言模型（LLM）可以执行多种任务，包括自动语音识别（ASR）、时间戳预测（TS）和语音翻译（ST）。语音大语言模型的联合训练会产生任务间的权衡，然而使用固定损失权重的标准训练通常无法根据部署偏好来控制所产生的权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EA-SURF（沿帕累托前沿的端点锚定偏好感知均匀采样），这是一种先验方法，通过调整标量化权重，使产生的任务权衡能够反映期望的偏好。EA-SURF保留了标准的加权损失训练流程，跟踪当前模型相对于各任务特定参考的性能，并随着训练的进行自适应地调整标量化权重。我们从理论上证明了EA-SURF能够匹配期望的偏好，在可检验的正则性条件下，更新在目标点处趋于平稳。
tldr: 提出EA-SURF方法，通过在训练中自适应调整标量化权重，使多任务语音大语言模型的任务间权衡符合期望的部署偏好，并从理论上证明了该方法能够收敛到目标偏好。
en_tdlr: EA-SURF adaptively adjusts scalarization weights during training so that task trade-offs in multi-task speech LLMs align with desired deployment preferences, with theoretical guarantees of convergence to the target preference.
